newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady tracking sideways futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady tracking sideways futures.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended steady to slightly higher on Wednesday, tracking generally sideways prices in crude and gasoline futures.
Eurograde barges rose $1 on the bid side to $219/$220 fob ARA with few deals heard. Regular unleaded remained thinner, due to tight availability, ending at $214/$215.
The arbitrage to the U.S. was still believed to be open for only the larger vessels, while the smaller barge market was seen as adequately supplied in thinner trade.
"There's enough material around," said one trader who expected barge prices to weaken in the near term.
